datasets.name: control_results
queryLines:
SELECT
  control_id,
  control_name,
  control_domain,
  owner_role,
  test_id,
  test_name,
  pass_rate_pct,
  exception_count,
  population_count,
  effectiveness_band,
  test_result,
  effectiveness_sort
FROM
  grc_gold.control_test_results
ORDER BY
  effectiveness_sort,
  pass_rate_pct

datasets.name: vuln_sla
queryLines:
SELECT
  bu_name,
  tier,
  severity,
  total_findings,
  open_findings,
  open_past_sla,
  sla_compliance_pct,
  open_kev_findings,
  open_kev_past_14d,
  mean_days_to_remediate,
  oldest_open_days
FROM
  grc_gold.vuln_sla_compliance
ORDER BY
  open_past_sla DESC

datasets.name: narratives
queryLines:
SELECT
  test_id,
  control_name,
  effectiveness_band,
  pass_rate_pct,
  owner_narrative,
  auditor_commentary,
  array_join(recommended_actions, ' | ') AS recommended_actions
FROM
  grc_gold.control_failure_narrative
ORDER BY
  pass_rate_pct

datasets.name: kpi_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  kpi_id,
  kpi_domain,
  kpi_name,
  kpi_value,
  unit,
  target_value,
  target_direction,
  kpi_status,
  related_control_id,
  as_of_date
FROM
  grc_gold.grc_kpi_summary
ORDER BY
  kpi_domain,
  kpi_id

measures.name: open_residual_ale_usd
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_open THEN residual_ale_usd ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: avg_residual_score
measures.expr: AVG(CASE WHEN is_open THEN residual_score END)

config.source: SELECT asset_id, bu_name, tier, gap_priority, asset_category, gap_type FROM grc_gold.asset_coverage_gaps LATERAL VIEW explode(gap_types) g AS gap_type

datasets.name: top_identities
queryLines:
SELECT
  login,
  bu_name,
  user_type,
  risk_level,
  risk_score,
  is_orphan,
  signins_after_termination,
  is_privileged,
  is_enabled,
  phishing_resistant_mfa,
  mfa_type,
  array_join(risk_flags, ', ') AS risk_flags
FROM
  grc_gold.identity_risk
WHERE
  risk_score > 0
ORDER BY
  risk_score DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: policy_lifecycle
queryLines:
SELECT
  policy_id,
  policy_title,
  owner_email,
  lifecycle_stage,
  next_review_date,
  is_review_overdue,
  days_overdue,
  failing_control_count,
  expired_active_exceptions
FROM
  grc_gold.policy_lifecycle
ORDER BY
  days_overdue DESC

datasets.name: policy_conflicts
queryLines:
SELECT
  policy_id,
  doc_policy_title,
  has_register_conflict,
  review_date_mismatch,
  sla_conflict,
  owner_mismatch,
  version_mismatch,
  doc_next_review_date,
  register_next_review_date,
  doc_critical_remediation_days,
  enforced_critical_sla_days
FROM
  grc_silver.policy_document_extract
ORDER BY
  has_register_conflict DESC,
  policy_id

measures.name: privileged_without_pr_mfa
measures.expr: COUNT_IF(is_privileged AND is_enabled AND NOT coalesce(phishing_resistant_mfa, false))

datasets.name: phy_post_term
queryLines:
SELECT
  user_id,
  login,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  bu_name,
  hr_termination_date,
  first_badge_in_after_termination_ts_local,
  last_badge_in_after_termination_ts_local,
  badge_in_events_after_termination,
  badge_in_days_after_termination,
  days_termination_to_last_badge_in,
  array_join(sites_entered, ', ') AS sites_entered,
  array_join(doors_entered, ', ') AS doors_entered,
  restricted_zone_entries,
  denied_attempts_after_termination,
  idp_signins_after_termination,
  also_signed_in_idp_after_termination,
  severity,
  control_id,
  control_mapping
FROM
  grc_gold.physical_post_termination_badge_use
ORDER BY
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'High' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  badge_in_events_after_termination DESC

datasets.name: phy_visitors
queryLines:
SELECT
  visit_id,
  visit_date,
  site_code,
  area_visited,
  area_zone,
  is_dc1,
  visitor_name,
  visitor_company,
  host_email,
  is_escorted,
  nda_signed,
  is_signed_out,
  array_join(finding_types, ', ') AS finding_types,
  finding_count,
  severity,
  control_mapping
FROM
  grc_gold.physical_visitor_findings
ORDER BY
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'High' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  visit_date DESC

datasets.name: phy_zone
queryLines:
SELECT
  site_code,
  door_id,
  door_name,
  zone,
  event_date_local,
  forced_open_events,
  held_open_events,
  after_hours_access_events,
  denied_no_clearance_events,
  anomaly_events,
  array_join(denied_badge_ids, ', ') AS denied_badge_ids,
  array_join(anomaly_types, ', ') AS anomaly_types,
  first_anomaly_ts_local,
  last_anomaly_ts_local,
  first_anomaly_ts_utc,
  last_anomaly_ts_utc,
  severity,
  control_mapping
FROM
  grc_gold.physical_zone_anomalies
ORDER BY
  event_date_local,
  door_id

datasets.name: phy_badge_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date_local,
  site_code,
  zone,
  count(*) AS events,
  count_if(event_type <> 'ACCESS_GRANTED') AS non_granted_events,
  count_if(is_door_alarm) AS door_alarms
FROM
  grc_silver.badge_access_event
GROUP BY
  event_date_local,
  site_code,
  zone

datasets.name: phy_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  kpi_id,
  kpi_name,
  kpi_value,
  unit,
  target_value,
  kpi_status,
  related_control_id
FROM
  grc_gold.grc_kpi_summary
WHERE
  kpi_domain = 'Physical Security'
ORDER BY
  kpi_id
